notes.title: I'm sorry it has to come to this, but it's for the best.
notes.content: Solenars Edge II: Aurora of The Seventh Dawn was a game that was in hiatus much longer then the original Solenars Edge Rebirth. Solenars Edge Rebirth was and is received poorly. RPG maker games get a bad rep and the Solenars Edge Series relies on the maker. It unfortunately, for the wrong reasons doesn't get the attention and sales it deserves. Solenars Edge II: Aurora of The Seventh Dawn would be a project that would spend a minimum of 6 months to be made and 2 months to get paid from. Which could be like Solenars Edge Rebirth. Only around 1000 dollars for the entire year. During this current struggle, I cannot afford to waste time and effort like that. Especially alone and without funding. So, sadly. I will have to prematurely cancel and end production for Solenars Edge II: Aurora of The Seventh Dawn. Sequels are usually best for highly successful games that usually fund themselves. This is not the case. Either way, I hope you did enjoy and continue to enjoy the Solenars Edge Series. Keep in mind the end of the series is already finished in a 90 page short story book in your game's folder and you also have the in-between after-story DLC. If you want to finish the lore, nothing is stopping you but yourself. I also want to take the time to announce that just because I cancelled one project does not mean I am still not working. I am planning and working on two other games. One is an FPS, another is a secret. I will hopefully announce more details of the projects by the end of the year. Thank you and happy holidays.

notes.title: Solenars Edge Rebirth Sequel?
notes.content:
I'm in the point of my life where I am putting in more money into these games I don't have and using my time for updates. Releasing the games for free. No, I am not complaining and I am happy to help. I'm the kind of person who would give the clothes off my back to a stranger and don't need anyone to know it. The feeling is good enough for me. It sucks to report that I am and have been in debt since the release of Fesnia. I apologize for Fesnia as it's far from my best work. Now down to the point of this post. Solenars Edge Rebirth was a game made in my childhood till now. It was a on the side project worked on for years. I've improved, but some of the time there will be quirks. I can't tell if people like it or aren't interested it all. I made the game free because I wanted people to enjoy it, I'd do that for all my games but I need to get paid or I cannot continue. But, know the main purpose is to put the consumer first, not my wallet. So the thing is this. Do you guys want a Solenars Edge Rebirth Sequel? Will it be worth your time or mine? If you really think I should make a Solenars Edge Rebirth Sequel please share the post and put 100 likes. If the post does not make 100 likes by the end of this year. Then I will not make the sequel due to lack of interest. Regardless, I am working on a different project atm and it will be revealed soon.

Happy Holidays -Team Syukino-

notes.title: Solenars Edge Rebirth v1.3 update!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29687460/a7fbcafed73948c20774b7faf4a43016897a17cf.png[/img]

Hello guys, been a long time since I have been able to work on this game. The files have been out of reach for a bit and I am still trying to work on it. I could use your help in donations and in pointing out spelling issues. If you see an error, please shoot me an email at syukino56@gmaildotcom with a screen shot or info. Keep in mind this isn't an early access game and the game is complete from start to finish. So I will listen to all, but won't always be able to act. Without a moment to spare, let us get into the new update.

-Added in a brief Ternesta fight with a Soldier and Knight aiding the heroes.

-Added in a save point in Ternesta as Soren.

-Added in a Nature's Kiss *Antidote* in the Item Shop in the Town of Eternity.

-Added in a merchant at the Slyph Cave Entrance.

-Changed position of a treasure chest that was previously out of reach.

-Increased the amount of steps you need to take to run into a battle in Slyph Cave.

-Status effects are no longer left on after a battle.

-Changed Balthus' Cure spell to be learned at level 3 instead of 4.

-Gave Balthus the Remedy spell to cure some status effects.

-The choice to go to hell in chapter 5 no longer issues a game over if yes is chosen.

-Fixed some grammar.

-You can now choose to start from Balthus' Requiem or skip it completely 
and jump into Solenars Edge Rebirth. *Keep in mind you will lose a chunk of the story and a bit of rewards for skipping. You will also not be able to name Balthus' Companion.*

-The start with Emo Natsu has been completely removed, but you will see him throughout the game.

Donate here for better content overtime:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/872050/Solenars_Edge_Rebirth_Donation/

Donate here if you want to help immediately and get things done much quicker as well as help save Team Syukino in the long run.

https://www.paypal.me/SYukino

*All donations are optional and are not required.*

I want to say that although I appreciate any and all kinds of feedback. I am only human.

"Let us go where the world takes us~" -Syukino.

PS: I really hope this game isn't way too easy now. But, you know how to make it harder if it is. GL and have fun!

notes.title: Lore Explanation + Important Info
notes.content:
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29687460/270015941a6bce61d47b7624b6d05dfa2504b329.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29687460/b86187622d599f83489c1c477f8d0fc8d52815ab.png[/img][/url]
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29687460/a7fbcafed73948c20774b7faf4a43016897a17cf.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29687460/680807119406dadcacd9ba963d3077dc1e4c50fe.png[/img][/url]
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29687460/30d8e3e686bba5f57e08dec005d2f44288652156.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29687460/0a029d1a85586d638f4af2a2173bc1107e5d16ae.png[/img][/url]
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29687460/bffc6a8ef64503276f2b328cae1659aa1ca22601.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29687460/82489e70e9f85f88212943caec220b8fcba1c863.png[/img][/url]

Solenars Edge's story is quite massive and you cannot simply grasp it in one simple playthrough of Solenars Edge Rebirth. I will in short explain to you the order of the lore in the correct form.

Starting off the story is Solenars Edge: Balthus Requiem. Which is a prequel explaining the origins of Balthus and his journey alongside old legendary friends. 

Next up is Luvocious: Fantasy. The story centers around the Princess of Almachia named Yuki. Without going into any major spoilers, this story bridges the gap between Balthus Requiem and the start of Solenars Edge Rebirth.

Next is Solenars Edge Rebirth: Which is the main game in the story that has a whole ton of lore within it and you get to meet and know the story of Alcornagia and the characters.

Lastly the series ends with Solenars Edge II: Aurora of The Seventh Dawn.

A 80-90 page short story about another world that introduces a plethora of new characters and brings back old ones. Yes it is a sequel and yes it could become a playable game. But I cannot create it as their isn't enough support or desire for it, so the short story does finish it in a good way as an Alternative. *Also to Note* The story is based off the original appearences of the characters in Solenars Edge, not the remakes in Solenars Edge Rebirth.

Also on another note:
 These games are discontinued and will never be released and are non-cannon if you ever find a copy floating around on the internet.

Solenars Edge Legends
Solenars Edge Arena
Solenars Edge Champions
Solenars Edge 1.0-4.0 demos
Falnarion Tactics
Trials of Almachia
Destiny's Charge
Snowscape
Legend of Momo 1-5


Current Team Syukino Games:

http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/4321/Sword_and_Cane/

Important Info:
 
I want to uhm make something clear about the game's grammar. There is a disclaimer in the game's folder about it. When I originally made the game all those years ago, my education wasn't all that great. I was constantly up all day till like 3 am combating bugs with the scripts. So having a fully functional game that got you to start to finish was way more important to me then changing the grammar. Unfortunately, I did lose the original files of the game in a crash some time ago on an older PC. Which means, I cannot update the game any further even if I wanted to. Hopefully one day this can be recovered, but I wouldn't count on it. What matters is that the game is fully functional and beatable. If it wasn't, it would be pulled from the steam store no questions asked. I only price my games as what I think they are worth. But Solenars Edge Rebirth IMO is worth about 9.99 at best, but I didn't want to charge people more then what they thought it was worth. Restoration would be criminal to charge it more then 3.99 considering it's length. Luvocious is a game worth 19.99 and was very expensive to make. However, the sales are very bad and uhm I can't do much at the moment for the price as I am restricted with steam's rules. Anywho, these games aren't perfect, how good they are is dependant on the player and how much he/she enjoys them. The bottom line is this: I created these games for RPG fans to enjoy, by myself with limited funds and resources. These games may not be top-of-the-line, but they are most certaintly made with your enjoyment in mind.

notes.title: From the bottom of my heart...
notes.content:
I say thank you. It has been quite a journey, one filled with many hardships, sacrifice and lots and lots of time. Solenars Edge Rebirth didn't always start out as a game, it was a short story in high school. One I wasn't allowed to take home with me when I went and changed schools freshman year. Two years went by and I managed to remember the story one day on a nature walk. I began writing it down and expanding on it, creating it one day at a time. Eventually I decided to put it into a game and thanks to RPG Maker VX ACE, many friends both in and out of my life and years of hard work. My game was finally complete in December of 2015 as Solenars Edge.  I attempted to bring it to Steam Greenlight via steam, but I felt as if it wasn't good enough by my standards so I pulled it back shortly after. I remade it as Solenars Edge 2.0. Then a year later I spent a couple of months remastering it and making it as high as quality as I could. This result became Solenars Edge Rebirth and I tried my hand at Steam Greenlight again. Sadly, my work was spat on by the images alone because of the program I used. Still despite the harsh words and comments thrown at me, I carried on. When Steam Greenlight changed to Steam Direct, now was my chance. Now regardless of reviews and what people say or do. I tried my hardest and I hope you'll enjoy Solenars Edge Rebirth!  Solenars Edge Rebirth is coming August 1st. As a token of my thanks; *8192 or *8912. Use one of these codes at the start of the game to unlock the Adventurer's Set.  -Syukino.

*Only one code works.
~Upcoming game: Restoration (Coming Later This Year!)
~Look forward to my future projects.
